title: A Registered Genetic Tournament of Marine, Halophytic, and Native Prunus Salt-Response Modules in Compact Almond Root Systems
hypotheses: H1 (Efficacy): Transgenic composite-root almond candidates (C1-C6) will demonstrate >= 20% improvement in canopy area AUC under chronic 3.2 dS/m saline stress compared to empty-vector control (P(delta_k >= ln(1.20)) >= 0.90).
H2 (Non-Saline Guardrail): Constructs will exhibit <= 10% penalty in non-saline conditions (P(alpha_k - alpha_control < ln(0.90)) <= 0.10).
H3 (Mechanism Confirmation): Candidates will demonstrate directional biological mechanism confirmation in targeted physiological assays with P >= 0.90.
design: Nested blocked randomized factorial design (720 plants, 16 independent reservoir systems, 2 temporal runs, 8 transformation batches)
analysis_plan: Bayesian hierarchical mixed-effects model with weakly informative priors and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampling (PyMC/ArviZ)
stopping_rule: Pre-registered sample size N=720 with interim futility monitoring at N=360 and N=540
